classes.label: Saber duelist (melee with ranged pulls)
classes.role: melee with ranged pulls and a gap-closer
classes.signature_mechanic: melee flurry plus ranged force pulls; sprint to close distance
classes.progression: heal shares a cooldown group with another slot; the rotation drops that slot by hand

classes.label: Heavy AoE
classes.signature_mechanic: armour-break opener, delayed AoE, heavy-weapon crit only when that weapon is equipped
classes.progression: falls back to ranged-weapon variants when no heavy weapon is equipped

classes.label: Ranged kiter
classes.signature_mechanic: debuff opener, crit chain, refresh debuff on a timer
classes.progression: cooldown groups: using one tier locks the whole family

classes.label: Stealth burst
classes.signature_mechanic: a mark makes later hits proc bonus damage, then DoT stacks
classes.progression: stealth openers omitted because the client cannot see stealth state

classes.label: Pistol gun-for-hire
classes.signature_mechanic: burst opener, execute when low, escape then crowd-control defuse in panic
classes.progression: melee build needs a manual rotation override

classes.label: Tactical buffer
classes.signature_mechanic: stacks self-buffs, armour debuff, snare for melee
classes.progression: pistol filler only when a pistol is equipped

weapon_families.label: Weapon-kind gate
weapon_families.technique: classifies the equipped weapon and gates combo slots by kind; no weapon stats in this half

zones.label: Layered feathered zone
zones.technique: boundaries combine by max (fuzzy OR); a sub-layer inherits the parent amount when it has nothing of its own; four feather curves
zones.ref: src/terrain/sim/generator/layer.ts (affect from about line 545); src/terrain/sim/feather.ts lines 13-52; src/terrain/sim/types.ts lines 17-88

zones.label: Ring siting with minimum spacing
zones.technique: rings out from a centre, skip any candidate closer than the minimum spacing before probing, stop at N accepted

zones.label: Nearest-place pointer
zones.technique: cache one list, filter by category, sort nearest first, optional radius

zones.label: Hub tag set with aliases
zones.technique: 12 stable hub ids plus an alias table that resolves friendly words to one key

zones.label: Golden id-table pin
zones.technique: a unit test locks the category id table so a data bump fails CI

looks.label: Engage edge cue
looks.technique: poll every 250 ms; engage on first hit or target; disengage after 5 s of continuous quiet; use as a HUD edge and one stinger per engagement

looks.label: Stacked engage window (to fix)
looks.technique: the hit timer holds engaged for 10 s after a hit, then the watcher adds a 5 s quiet period, so a player leaves combat about 15 s after the last hit; pick one window

originals.name: Predictive Mender
originals.idea: a HUD prompt that shows when the player is under the soft floor and the predicted time to death is under warmup plus buffer, with a countdown ring
originals.keep: three thresholds (hard floor, soft floor, warmup plus buffer) and the refire lock
originals.change: our numbers held in zone data; corrected DPS window (defect D1: divide by elapsed time when the window is not full); a visible countdown instead of a silent fire. Parity rows 14 and 2

originals.name: Engage Edge
originals.idea: one engage state with one window: a short banner on the engage edge, one stinger per engagement, one quiet period
originals.change: one 10 s window (defect: the two windows stack to about 15 s); engage edge only, not every hit. Parity rows 4 and 14

originals.name: Class Kit as Data
originals.idea: opener, combo, filler and panic as a data table per class, each slot gated by the equipped weapon kind
originals.keep: the four-tier shape and the per-slot gate
originals.change: our kits and our names; no donor ability names. Parity rows 6 and 13

originals.name: Ring Siting for Camps
originals.idea: place camps, spawn points and shrines on buildable ground by rings out from a centre, with minimum spacing checked before any probe
originals.keep: ring order and the spacing rule
originals.change: a zone-data probe instead of a server call. Parity row 23

originals.name: Feathered Zone Edges
originals.idea: authored zone shapes with a per-zone feather width and a choice of easing curve
originals.keep: four curves and fuzzy-OR of overlapping regions
originals.change: our shapes and our zone data fields. Parity row 20
